title: AppraisalFinding
description: ITIP data archetype — appraisal finding output. Rootless (no GSM base extension). Types the effect payload emitted by appraisal Mechanisms when a governance issue is detected. Each finding identifies the rule that was violated, the nature of the issue, the affected subject, and a human-readable diagnostic message. Source: ITIP (domain archetype for governance appraisal).

ruleType.description: Appraisal rule type URI that produced this finding.

findingType.description: Nature of the governance issue. GAP — something expected is missing. CONFLICT — two artifacts contradict each other. DRIFT — something changed or aged past threshold. VIOLATION — a Norm assertion evaluates to false. METRIC — a quantitative indicator exceeds threshold.

subjectType.description: GSM subject type of the affected entity.

subjectDefinitionId.description: Definition ID of the affected entity.

severity.description: Severity level of the finding. HIGH — governance intent is not realized. MEDIUM — governance quality is degraded. LOW — informational observation.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic message explaining the finding and its governance impact.
